lines.japanese: きのうと同じコーヒー屋。時刻は２１時ちょい前だった。
lines.english: The same coffee shop as yesterday. It was just shy of nine at night.

lines.japanese: おいおい、あの糞ワシ野郎、バイトの方はどうなってんだ。アレキサンダーはまだ営業時間中のはずだぞ。
lines.english: Come on. What the hell was that shitbird doing about his shift? Alexander ought to still be open.

lines.japanese: あいつ、ほんとにバイト辞めたのか……？　それとも、まさか無断欠勤とか……？
lines.english: Had he really quit...? Or, no—was he skipping work without even calling...?

lines.japanese: いや、そりゃ俺だって、ひとには言えない例の事情のせいで、やむなく現場へ行けなかったことは何度かある。だから世間の立派なお父さんみたいに、規律を守れないやつはダメだなんて言えた義理じゃない。
lines.english: Sure, circumstances I couldn’t tell anyone about had kept me from the job site more than once. I was hardly in a position to sound like some upright father lecturing people about discipline.

lines.japanese: ただ気になるのは、やつの様子がここンとこ妙だってこと。
lines.english: What bothered me was how strange he'd been acting lately.

lines.japanese: 俺はクソ苦いコーヒーをちびちび舐めながらすこし考えてみた……が、やめた。こっちにはこっちの予定もある。
lines.english: I lapped at the godawful bitter coffee in tiny sips and gave the matter some thought... then stopped. I had plans of my own.

lines.japanese: もし鷲介にでっかい悩みや考えがあるなら、じきに≪面談≫でも持ちかけてくるだろう。俺たちの間に遠慮なんて必要ないはずだ。そして恐らくは残された時間も。
lines.english: If Shusuke had something big on his mind, sooner or later he’d ask for an *Interview*. There was no need for the two of us to hold back. And, most likely, no time left to.

lines.japanese: 俺は会計を済ませると、待っているひとがいる場所へ向かって夜の街へ駆けだした。
lines.english: I paid, then raced out into the night toward the person waiting for me.

lines.japanese: 「で、どーなの、そっちの調子は」
lines.english: “So? How're things on your end?”

lines.japanese: 「はー、ぼちぼちですねー」
lines.english: “Oh, so-so.”

lines.japanese: 俺がグローヴ街に着いたとき、鳴はいつか二人で話した階段に腰を下ろしていた。
lines.english: When I reached Grove Street, Naru was sitting on the steps where the two of us had talked once before.

lines.japanese: ひとりでもこの場所にいたってことは、俺の勧めたこの街への溶けこみ方に共感できたってことなのかな。そんなところで些細な感性が合致するなら、悪い気はしなかった。
lines.english: She had come here on her own. Did that mean she’d taken to the way I’d suggested she make herself at home in this city? Finding our tastes aligned in one small thing like that felt good.

lines.japanese: 「まあホラ、しばらく授業とか休んでたじゃん。付いてけてんの」
lines.english: “I mean, you missed classes for a while, right? You keeping up?”

lines.japanese: 尋ねていい問題かちょっと迷ったもののズバリ突っこんだ。以前ならともかく、いまは遠慮する関係でもないだろう。
lines.english: I hesitated over whether I should ask, then went straight in. Maybe once, but we weren't distant enough now to tiptoe around each other.

lines.japanese: 「ええまー、そーですねー……」
lines.english: “Well, yes... I suppose...”

lines.japanese: 言葉を選んでいるのか、鳴はしばし口を開けたまま固まった。
lines.english: Maybe she was choosing her words. Naru froze for a moment, mouth still open.

lines.japanese: 「あの私ー、平日は図書館に行ったりしてたじゃないですかー」
lines.english: “You know how I used to go to the library on weekdays?”

lines.japanese: 「その間なにもしてなかったわけじゃなくて、いちおー授業分くらいの勉強はしてたんですよー。えーまー、独学なんですけどー」
lines.english: “It isn't like I did nothing all that time. I kept up with about as much studying as we'd have covered in class. On my own, of course.”

lines.japanese: 「ただまあ、亜衣ちゃんはそうじゃないみたいで、頼まれれば勉強教えたりしてるんですけどー、あー……なんと言いますか……」
lines.english: “Ai apparently didn't, though, so I help her study when she asks. But, um... How should I put this...?”

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「しばらく学校に来てなかったふたりが、とつぜん仲良く登校してきたりしたら、そらまー好奇の目に晒されますよねー」
lines.english: “If two girls who’ve been away from school for a while suddenly start showing up together, all friendly, of course people are going to stare.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そかー。そーゆーん、あるかもなー」
lines.english: “Oh. Yeah. Guess that could happen.”

lines.japanese: また学校に通いはじめた鳴だが、いろいろとヘコまされることはあるらしい。
lines.english: Naru had started attending again, but apparently school still found plenty of ways to knock the wind out of her.

lines.japanese: 最近の、しかも女所帯の学校事情なんて知らない俺には、自信を持って言ってやれることなんかない。だからせめて、他では言えない愚痴や弱音ぐらい吐きださせてやりたい。
lines.english: I knew nothing about schools these days, least of all all-girls schools, so there was nothing I could tell her with confidence. The least I could give her was a place to spill the complaints and fears she couldn't voice anywhere else.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、いいじゃん。ひとりで孤立するよりは、ふたりのが全然マシじゃん」
lines.english: “Still, it's fine. Two of you together is one hell of a lot better than being isolated alone.”

lines.japanese: 「ですねー、はい。ふたりだから助かってる部分のがはるかに多いんで、まーそれはいいんです」
lines.english: “Yes. That’s true. Having the two of us helps far more often than it hurts, so that part is fine.”

lines.japanese: 「ほー。じゃ何がまずいの」
lines.english: “Okay. So what’s the problem?”

lines.japanese: 「ややや、まずいとかじゃないんですけど、なんてゆかー、ほら亜衣ちゃんかわいい性格だから、ぼちぼち色んなひとと話をしたりとかしててー」
lines.english: “Oh, no, I wouldn't call it a problem. It's more that—well, Ai has such an endearing personality. Little by little she's started talking with all sorts of people...”

lines.japanese: 「あー、あいつ無駄に馴れ馴れしいもんな」
lines.english: “Yeah, she's needlessly chummy.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、そんな亜衣ちゃんを見てると、相変わらず集合体へ溶けこめない自分に不安を覚えますよねー。仕切り直しでスタートは同じなのになー、はー、どうして私ダメなんだろー」
lines.english: “And when I watch her, I start worrying because I still can't melt into the group. We both got the same fresh start, so why am I still so useless at this?”

lines.japanese: 「べつにダメじゃねえだろ。んな、一日二日でなんとかなるもんじゃねーし、仮になんとかならなくたって死ぬわけじゃねーし」
lines.english: “You're not useless. This isn't something you fix in a day or two, and if you never fix it, you won't die.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、隼人さんは慰めてくれますけどー」
lines.english: “You say that to comfort me, Hayato...”

lines.japanese: 「おお、じゃよかったじゃん。コレすげー特典。なかなか他人は慰めねえよ俺」
lines.english: “Great, then. What an incredible perk. I don't go around comforting just anybody.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ほんとー」
lines.english: “Oh. That’s true.”

lines.japanese: 納得されてしまった。不思議系の昆虫でも見るようにポカンと口を開けている。
lines.english: She took that at face value and stared at me, mouth open, as though I were some strange new species of insect.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、隼人さんから見た私の長所っていうか、気に入っていただいてる部分って何なんですかねー」
lines.english: “Um, from your perspective, Hayato, what would you say my good points are? What is it you like about me?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだその質問。ひとをさぞかしマニアックなもの好きみたいに言うのやめてくんない」
lines.english: “What kind of question is that? Could you quit making me sound like a connoisseur of some incredibly specialized taste?”

lines.japanese: 俺はボケに対するツッコミのつもりで言いきった。しかし鳴はこっちを見上げたまま止まっている。どうやらボケではなくマジ質だったらしい。
lines.english: I delivered it as the straight man's answer to a joke. Naru kept staring up at me, perfectly still. Apparently it wasn't a joke. She was asking for real.
“Well, I mean...”

lines.japanese: 要はカノジョのどこが好きなのか言えってことだろ。改めて聞かれると難しい。こっぱずかしいのもあるけど、それを差しひいても……うーん、難しい。
lines.english: Basically, she wanted me to say what I liked about my girlfriend. Hard when somebody asked you outright. Embarrassing too, but even setting that aside... Yeah. Hard.

lines.japanese: 「そんなん、一言でスパッと説明できるようなモンでもねーしなあ」
lines.english: “It’s not the kind of thing I can explain neatly in one sentence.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ長文でいいです」
lines.english: “A long answer is acceptable.”

lines.japanese: いや、そういう問題でも……というニュアンスを込めて顔をしかめてみせたが、やつは怯まなかった。
lines.english: I frowned, trying to convey that length wasn't the issue. She would not be discouraged.

lines.japanese: 「ん……前にも言ったけど、ほら、おまえヘンなやつじゃん」
lines.english: “Mm... I said it before. You're weird, see.”

lines.japanese: 俺はあぐらを組みなおして膝に頬杖をさした。
lines.english: I recrossed my legs and propped my cheek on one knee.

lines.japanese: 「つか、なんつーの、ヘンなやつチームの中でもまたベクトルの違うヘンなやつじゃん」
lines.english: “I mean, how do I put it? Even on Team Weirdo, you're weird along a completely different axis.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、鳳鳴そんなにヘンなやつですか」
lines.english: “Is Naru Otori truly so strange?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃもう、俺が知りうる限りの中でも、かなり上位の部類に入るヘンなやつだろ」
lines.english: “Oh, absolutely. Of all the people I know, you're way up in the highest ranks of weird.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、すみません、ここからぐわんと持ちあげていただける展開が待っているんでしょうか。そうでなければわたくしこの辺でもうそろそろ。はい」
lines.english: “Excuse me. Is there a dramatic turn ahead where you swing all the way up into lavish praise? If not, I may take my leave around here. Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、持ちあげるも何も、べつに落としてねえから。どっちかっつーと誉め言葉だしコレ」
lines.english: “What swing upward? I never put you down. This is closer to a compliment.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、そうなんですか」
lines.english: “Oh. Was it?”

lines.japanese: 「ま、世間的にはそうじゃねーかもしんないけど」
lines.english: “Maybe not by society's standards.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、やっぱり落としましたねー」
lines.english: “Ah. So you did put me down.”

lines.japanese: 「まァまァ世間的には浮くんだけどさ、その浮き具合ってのが色々あんじゃん。どっちに、どのぐらい、どんなふうにとかって」
lines.english: “Sure, society might think you stick out. But there are all kinds of sticking out, right? Which direction, how far, in what way...”

lines.japanese: 「その浮き具合が似てるっつーか、いや似てるわけでもねーのかな、まあ噛み合わせいいじゃんって思えたのが俺の場合おまえだったわけで」
lines.english: “The way you stick out is like mine—or maybe it isn't. Either way, you were the person I found I fit with.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなもんフィーリングが合ったとしか言いようがないだろ。どこが好きかなんて、いちいち細けーこと挙げようがねえし。要は全体が好きなわけなんだから」
lines.english: “All I can say is that we click. I can't list every tiny thing I like. The point is, I like all of you.”

lines.japanese: アレ？　俺なに言ってるんだ……？
lines.english: Wait. What the hell was I saying...?

lines.japanese: ふと我に返って自問したのは、やつが驚いてるんだか喜んでるんだか笑いを堪えてるんだかよく分からない、不気味な表情で俺を凝視していることに気付いたときだった。
lines.english: I came abruptly to myself when I noticed her staring at me with a disturbing expression. Shocked? Delighted? Struggling not to laugh? I couldn't tell.

lines.japanese: く、くそ……つい流れで、いかにも付き合いたてバカップルみたいなロマン言を吐いてしまった。
lines.english: D-damn it... Carried along by the conversation, I'd spouted exactly the kind of romantic nonsense you'd expect from an idiotic couple who'd just started dating.
“Ha—”
“Hagh...!”

lines.japanese: 鳴がとつぜん制服の胸をつかんだ。
lines.english: Naru suddenly clutched the front of her school uniform.

lines.japanese: 「い、射抜かれた……」
lines.english: “Y-you pierced me straight through...”

lines.japanese: うずくまった。
lines.english: She doubled over.

lines.japanese: 「やーん、ハヤトったらーん」
lines.english: “Ohhh, Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 擦りよってきた。
lines.english: She slid up against me.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、幸せすぎて恐い……」
lines.english: “I’m almost afraid to be this happy...”

lines.japanese: 酔っていた。
lines.english: She was drunk on it.

lines.japanese: 安い幸せだなあ。
lines.english: Didn’t take much to make her happy.

lines.japanese: ま、喜んでるからいいか。
lines.english: Well, she was pleased. Good enough.

lines.japanese: 「この程度でいいならまた慰めてやるから」
lines.english: “If that's all it takes, I'll comfort you again sometime.”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴の背中を叩いて言った。
lines.english: I said it with a pat on Naru's back.

lines.japanese: 「頑張れそう」
lines.english: “Think you can keep at it?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それはもう、なんだか小さなことで悩んでる自分が恥ずかしくなる勢いです」
lines.english: “Oh, absolutely. I’m almost embarrassed I was worrying over something so small.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃよかった」
lines.english: “Good to hear.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー、実によかったですー」
lines.english: “Yes. Very good indeed.”

lines.japanese: 鳴はまだ俺の顔を見ていた。俺はなんとなく道路の……なんだかよく分らないものを見てた。
lines.english: Naru kept looking at my face. I stared down at the road—at something on it. What, I couldn’t have said.

lines.japanese: そのまましばらくふたり、何も話さずぼーっと座っていた。
lines.english: We sat that way awhile, saying nothing, staring vacantly ahead.

lines.japanese: 単に新しい話題が思いつかなかっただけなんだけど、それでも気まずい雰囲気にならない安心感が心地よかった。
lines.english: We'd simply run out of things to say. Even so, the comfort of knowing the silence would not turn awkward felt good.

lines.japanese: いままでひとりでこの階段から街を眺めているときは、俺の中に何かが入りこんでくる気がした。
lines.english: When I sat alone on these steps and watched the city, I always felt as though something from it flowed into me.

lines.japanese: だけど今日はふたりの中に同じ何かが入ってくるように感じた。
lines.english: Today it felt as though that same something flowed into both of us.

lines.japanese: 「くしっ」
lines.english: “Achoo.”

lines.japanese: ただまあ、このままずっと居続けるには季節が優しくなかった。
lines.english: Still, the season was not kind enough to let us stay there forever.

lines.japanese: 「場所変えるか」
lines.english: “Wanna go somewhere else?”

lines.japanese: 俺は立ちあがって、尻についた砂をぱんぱんと払った。
lines.english: I rose and slapped the grit from my backside.

lines.japanese: 「あー、そーですねー。それではデートの続きとまいりましょうか」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. Shall we proceed with the rest of our date?”

lines.japanese: 「だな」
lines.english: “Sure.”

lines.japanese: 「え……あれ、あの、今日は否定とか訂正とかしないんですか」
lines.english: “Oh... Wait. Um, you're not denying it or correcting me today?”

lines.japanese: 「なんで。付きあってる男女が約束して出てきてんだから、今日のはフツーにデートだろ」
lines.english: “Why would I? We’re dating, and we made plans to meet up. That makes this a date.”

lines.japanese: 「あ……はい、そうですか」
lines.english: “Oh... Yes. I see.”

lines.japanese: 下を向いてしまった。自分から言いだしたくせして、なに照れてんだこいつ。
lines.english: She lowered her face. She was the one who'd said it; what was she blushing for?

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃあ、こんな……とかも？」
lines.english: “Then, um... would this sort of thing count too?”

lines.japanese: ぴた、と俯いたまま俺に並んで肩を当ててくる。相変わらず根は臆病なやつだ。
lines.english: Still looking down, she slid neatly alongside until her shoulder touched mine. Timid at the root, same as ever.

lines.japanese: 「ん。こんなとかも」
lines.english: “Yeah. This sort of thing too.”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴の肩に腕を回して引きよせた。
lines.english: I put an arm around Naru's shoulders and drew her in.

lines.japanese: 「う、うはー、手おおきいー」
lines.english: “O-oh, wow. Such a big hand.”

lines.japanese: 照れ隠しでテンション上げにかかったみたいだ。
lines.english: Apparently she planned to hide her embarrassment by ratcheting up the energy.

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Yep.”

lines.japanese: 「やーもー、包みこむような男のひと、すすす素敵ですー」
lines.english: “Oh my, a man who wraps you in his arms... s-s-so wonderful.”

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Yep.”

lines.japanese: 「あのー、それで次はどこへ向かう予定でしょうかー」
lines.english: “Um, and where are we planning to go next?”

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Yep.”

lines.japanese: 予定は特に決めていなかった。
lines.english: I hadn't planned anywhere in particular.

lines.japanese: 「はー、予定は未定ですかー」
lines.english: “Ah. So our plans remain unplanned?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、じゃー、この辺ぶらっと回るか」
lines.english: “Well, then... wanna wander around here?”

lines.japanese: 「いまずっと見てたのにですかー？」
lines.english: “After we've spent all this time looking at it?”

lines.japanese: 「つっても他に行くとこなんかねぇしなあ」
lines.english: “Yeah, but there's nowhere else to go.”

lines.japanese: 「はあー、ないんですかー」
lines.english: “Oh. Nowhere?”

lines.japanese: 「まず金がねえから」
lines.english: “First problem: I'm broke.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、そればっかりは仕方ないですねー」
lines.english: “Ah. There’s no helping that, then.”

lines.japanese: 「でも私……好きなひとと一緒に居られればそれだけで充分です。フヒヒ」
lines.english: “But I... I need nothing more than the company of the man I love. Heh heh heh.”

lines.japanese: 「慣れないキャラ作んな。笑い方に本性滲みでてンぞ」
lines.english: “Don't force a character that doesn't suit you. Your true nature's seeping out through the laugh.”

lines.japanese: しかし……馬鹿話はいいとして、実際どこ行ったもんか。俺たちはいったん座りなおして考える。
lines.english: Still... enough fooling around. Where could we actually go? We sat back down to think.

lines.japanese: 「んー、金かかんないで長居できるとこねーかな。メンマんとこもパルさんとこも、さすがに飽きてきた感があるし」
lines.english: “Mm. Know anywhere we can hang around without spending money? We’ve been going to Menma’s and Paru’s so much, even those places are getting old.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか、そう毎度お邪魔してたらご迷惑ですしー」
lines.english: “And we'd be imposing if we barged in every time.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、タダで時間気にせずくつろげるっつーたら、そりゃ自宅が最強なんだけど。このあとバイトだから、今日は無理だし」
lines.english: “Well, if you want somewhere to lounge free without watching the clock, home is unbeatable. But I have work later, so today's no good.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、すみません。もしバイトがなかったとしても、うち、父がいる日はちょっと……」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm sorry. Even if you didn't have work, my place is a little... difficult when Father is there.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ああ、いや自宅って、俺ん家のつもりで言ったんだけど」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, no. By home, I meant mine.”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ、隼人さんの家って、私行ってもいいんですか？」
lines.english: “Wait. I'm allowed to visit your house?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、いんじゃね。家の連中には前もって話しておくよ」
lines.english: “Sure, why not? I'll tell everyone ahead of time.”

lines.japanese: ちょっとした波紋を呼びそうだけど。いろんな意味で。でも、いずれはぶつかる問題だ。
lines.english: It would probably cause a few ripples. In any number of senses. Still, we'd have to face the issue eventually.

lines.japanese: 「はー、家族公認……いい言葉ですねー。じゃあ、こんど鳴さん食材もっさり持って、愛情手料理を作りに伺っちゃいますねー」
lines.english: “Ah, officially accepted by his family... Lovely words. Then one of these days, yours truly will arrive with mountains of ingredients and prepare a home-cooked feast full of love.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、なに、おまえ料理とか上手いの」
lines.english: “Oh? What, you're a good cook?”

lines.japanese: 「わー、どきどきー、未来のお嫁入り先はどんなお宅なんでしょー」
lines.english: “Ooh, my heart is pounding. What sort of home awaits me at my future in-laws'?”

lines.japanese: そんな上手いってわけではないようだ。
lines.english: Apparently she wasn't much of a cook.

lines.japanese: 「つか、そうだ……そういや、うちなら、こないだ鳳が来たぞ」
lines.english: “Speaking of my place... Otori came by the other day.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なんで、え、どゆこと？　うちの翔が隼人さん家にお邪魔したんですか？」
lines.english: “What? Why? What does that mean? My Kakeru visited your house?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、お邪魔っつうか、フツーに邪魔だったな。ダジャレ豚のでっけーワゴン、うちの前に横付けさせて。いきなり乗れとか言っちゃって」
lines.english: “I wouldn't say visited. More like barged in. He pulled up out front in the pun-pig's enormous wagon and told me to get in.”

lines.japanese: 「やー！　やだもー、何やってんのあのひとー！　恥ずかしいなーあ！」
lines.english: “No! Oh, honestly, what was that man doing? How embarrassing!”
“Mm... Hm?”

lines.japanese: 肉親のことで恥入る鳴は、その一瞬、俺の知っている鳴とは微妙に別人のようだった。
lines.english: For that instant, Naru's mortification over her own family made her seem subtly unlike the Naru I knew.

lines.japanese: なんだか家庭内での顔を垣間見た気がした。
lines.english: I felt as though I'd glimpsed the face she wore at home.

lines.japanese: 「なあ、そういやおまえ、鳳のことなんて呼んでンの」
lines.english: “Hey, come to think of it, what do you call Otori?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　えっ、なんですいきなり？」
lines.english: “What? Why ask that all of a sudden?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、なんでってこともないけど、なんとなく。ホラおまえいつも、うちの兄がーとか、うちのカケルがーみたいな感じでしか言わないから、ふだん直接本人を呼ぶときはどんなんかと思って」
lines.english: “No reason. Just wondered. You only ever say ‘my brother’ or ‘my Kakeru.’ Got curious what you call him to his face.”

lines.japanese: 「ふだん直接……」
lines.english: “To his face...”
“...Brother?”

lines.japanese: 「いまの間はなに」
lines.english: “What was that pause?”

lines.japanese: 「や、べつに。全然。いたって普通ですよ。兄さんとか、お兄ちゃんとか、そういうありがちな感じで」
lines.english: “Nothing. Not remotely. Perfectly ordinary. ‘Brother,’ ‘big brother’—the usual sort of thing.”

lines.japanese: 「へー。え、でも、今それにしちゃ考えてなかった？」
lines.english: “Huh. But didn't you just have to think of one?”

lines.japanese: 「や、べつに。全然。兄さん最近アトリエに篭りっぱなしみたいだけど、ちゃんとご飯食べてるのかなーとか、ふとそんな他愛もない考えがよぎっただけです」
lines.english: “No. Not at all. I merely happened to wonder whether Brother is eating properly, since he appears to spend every hour shut in his studio lately. An unrelated, idle thought.”

lines.japanese: 「アトリエ……なに、あいつアトリエなんか持ってんの」
lines.english: “Studio...? What, he owns a studio?”

lines.japanese: そういや鳳翔は裏じゃ──訂正、表じゃイラストレーターなんかやってるっつう話だったな。
lines.english: Come to think of it, Kakeru Otori worked as an illustrator on the shady side—no, the respectable side—of things.

lines.japanese: 「へえー、最近はそっちの方も真面目にやってんだ……そういやあれ以来会ってねーけど、まだ生きてンのかな」
lines.english: “Huh. So he's actually taking that seriously lately... Haven't seen him since all that. Wonder if he's alive.”

lines.japanese: 「イェア！　鳳凰寺カケルならいずれ世界中の壁っちゅー壁をクールなグラフィティに変えちまう予定だぜ、ハッハー！」
lines.english: “Yeah! Kakeru Hououji is gonna turn every wall in the whole world into one cool piece of graffiti someday! Ha-ha!”

lines.japanese: 「はっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！」
lines.english: “Ah!”

lines.japanese: 「ハッハー！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha!”

lines.japanese: 会話のどこから聞かれていたのか、待っていたかのようなタイミングで巨体が現れた。その後ろには例によってもうふたり。
lines.english: A giant appeared with timing so perfect he might have been waiting for his cue—God knew how much he'd heard. As usual, two more trailed behind.

lines.japanese: 「おまえらか……」
lines.english: “Oh. You guys...”

lines.japanese: 「イヨゥ、ファルコン＆リルシスタ！　この街ギバラで何してるんだい、愛してるのかい、ランデブーでも交わしてんのかい。こそこそ二人で隠れてねえで、早くこっち来いよ」
lines.english: “Yo, Falcon and li’l sis! What’re you doing here in Gibara City? In love? Having yourselves a little rendezvous? Quit hiding away and get over here.”

lines.japanese: 「ヤーマン！　成田っちも鳴タロも、ハッピーこん・にち・ワ～！　偶然の再会に一服いっとく～？」
lines.english: “Ya man! Narita, Naru-boy—a happy hel-lo! Shall we smoke one to celebrate this chance reunion?”

lines.japanese: 「ちゅーか、なんスか、なに二人きりで遊んでんスか！　ちょちょちょ、俺らとも遊んでくださいよォ！」
lines.english: “Seriously, what's this? Why're you two off having fun alone? C'mon, c'mon, play with us too!”

lines.japanese: 「さ、行くか鳴」
lines.english: “Let's go, Naru.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、行きましょう隼人さん」
lines.english: “Yes. Let's, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「くるぁ～！　なに逃げとんねんオドレらぁ！」
lines.english: “Heyyy! Where the hell d'you think you're escaping to?”

lines.japanese: 「つぅ……耳元で叫ぶなよバカ……」
lines.english: “Ow... Don’t yell right in my ear, idiot...”

lines.japanese: 「だーって、ガン無視とかひでえッスよ隼人先輩！　チョー鬼じゃないスか！　うーわテンション下がるわァ～、あんた、男の友情より女のご機嫌を取るようなひとだったのかよ」
lines.english: “But ignoring us completely is cruel, Hayato! That's straight-up demonic! Man, you killed my whole mood. You're really the kind of guy who'd choose keeping a woman happy over friendship between men?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そもそも、おまえらとの友情なんて選択肢はねーし」
lines.english: “Friendship with you people was never among the options.”

lines.japanese: 「おいおいマイメン、照れるこたねえ。俺らハメたりハメられたり舐めたり舐められたりした仲じゃねえか」
lines.english: “Come on, my man, don’t be shy. We’ve played each other and been played, licked and been licked—”

lines.japanese: 「ああもう、こいつに関してはツッコむ気すら起きねーわ。ん……？　つうかアレか、おまえらがいるってことは、ひょっとしてあいつも──」
lines.english: “I can't even summon the will to correct this one. Hm...? Wait. If you guys are here, does that mean maybe he's here too—”

lines.japanese: 「えー？　あいつって、どなたですかー」
lines.english: “Hm? Who is this 'he'?”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　るー」
lines.english: “Huh? Roo?”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　かーくん」
lines.english: “Huh? Kaa?”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　いまこの子ら、なんて言った？」
lines.english: “Hm? What did those two just call each other?”

lines.japanese: 「なんスかね、お互いめっちゃアットホームな仇名で呼んだような気がすンスけど」
lines.english: “Dunno. Sounded like they used some seriously homey pet names.”

lines.japanese: 「ばか、触れないでやれ。両方とも赤面してるだろ」
lines.english: “Idiots, leave it alone. Look, they're both blushing.”

lines.japanese: 「あれー、クソ妹じゃーん。あはは、まだ生きてたんだー」
lines.english: “Oh, look. My piece-of-shit sister. Ha-ha. You're still alive?”

lines.japanese: 「あらー、兄さんこそご壮健のようで何よりですわーほほほ」
lines.english: “Why, Kakeru. How delightful to find you in robust health. Ha ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「やり直した」
lines.english: “They restarted.”

lines.japanese: 「やり直したッスね」
lines.english: “They definitely restarted.”

lines.japanese: 「ばか、触れないでやれ。両方とも赤くなってるだろ」
lines.english: “Idiots, leave them alone. Look, they’re both turning red.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはっ！　俺、赤面した皇帝なんて初めて見たわ」
lines.english: “Pfft! First time I've ever seen the Emperor blush.”

lines.japanese: 「鳴さんは鳴さんで、リテイクついでにお嬢様キャラんなろうとしてますよ。ちょっと図々しくねーすか」
lines.english: “And Naru used the retake to turn herself into a refined young lady. Isn't that a little shameless?”

lines.japanese: 「ばか、触れないでやれ。両方とも赤くなってるだろ」
lines.english: “Idiots, leave them alone. Look, they're both turning red.”

lines.japanese: 「イェア！　仲よきことは美しきかな、この際みんなで乾杯しようぜ！」
lines.english: “Yeah! ‘How beautiful it is when people get along.’ Let’s all raise a glass!”

lines.japanese: 鳳（兄）が全員分の支払いを持つというので、場所をコーヒー屋に移した。
lines.english: Otori—the brother—offered to pay for everyone, so we moved to the coffee shop.

lines.japanese: 「で、隼人ぉ～？　おまえは相ッ変わらず退屈な人生送ってんのお？」
lines.english: “So, Hayatooo? Still living the same tedious life?”

lines.japanese: 「……そう言うおまえは相ッ変わらず感じ悪りーな」
lines.english: “...And you're still every bit as unpleasant.”

lines.japanese: 鳳に話があると言われて、俺はやつと同じテーブルに向かい合わせで座っていた。
lines.english: Otori said he wanted to talk, so I sat across from him at the same table.

lines.japanese: 鳴とアホ三人は隣りのテーブル。こちらの卓とは、ちょっと声を張れば届くけど、ちょっと声を絞れば聞かれないで済む、ぐらいの距離だ。
lines.english: Naru and the three idiots sat at the next table: close enough for a raised voice to carry, far enough that a lowered one would not.

lines.japanese: 鳳が俺とふたりだけで交わしたい話、他のやつの耳に入れたくない話。それは容易に想像がつく──
lines.english: What Otori wanted to discuss alone—what he wanted kept from the others—was easy to imagine.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ。またあいつに替わってよ」
lines.english: “Hey. Change into him again.”

lines.japanese: ──もちろん伊丹伽楼羅の件だ。
lines.english: Karura Itami, naturally.

lines.japanese: 「無理。替わり方わかんねーし、もちろん替わる気さらさらねーし」
lines.english: “Can't. Don't know how to switch, and even if I did, I have absolutely no intention of doing it.”

lines.japanese: 「あーあ。せっかく慎重に手ぇ回して感動の再会果たしたと思ったら、次の日にはもう帰っちゃってンだもんなあ」
lines.english: “What a waste. I pulled strings and moved so carefully, finally got my touching reunion, and he went home the very next day.”

lines.japanese: 「おーい伽楼羅ぁ、聞いてるー？　また出てこいよー」
lines.english: “Heeey, Karura! You listening? Come back out!”

lines.japanese: 「やめろ。腹に語りかけるな。俺は妊婦か」
lines.english: “Stop talking to my stomach. What am I, pregnant?”

lines.japanese: 「なあ、伽楼羅ぁー。成田隼人もそこそこ馬鹿だから笑えンだけど、やっぱ伽楼羅のギャグに比べたらぜんぜん素人だよー」
lines.english: “Come on, Karura. Hayato Narita's stupid enough to get a few laughs, but beside your comedy, he's a complete amateur.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　誰が素人だテメ、なめんじゃ……あ、いや間違った。おお、そうだよ、俺は素人だよ。芸人じゃねーんだよ。面白くなくて結構だっつの」
lines.english: “The fuck? Who're you calling amateur, asshole? Don't— Wait, no. Wrong. Yeah. I am an amateur. I'm not a comedian. I'm perfectly content not to be funny.”

lines.japanese: 「ほーんと、隼人だったらまだシュウちゃんの方が面白いもんなぁー」
lines.english: “Honestly, even Shu is funnier than Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ……馬鹿かおまえ、んなわけねーだろ。いくら素人つっても、あいつにだけは負けてねえよ。そらねーわ。そらテメエのセンスが悪いだけだ」
lines.english: “Are you— Are you an idiot? No damn way. I may be an amateur, but I do not lose to him. Impossible. Your taste just sucks.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁー」
lines.english: “Siiiigh.”

lines.japanese: しかし俺の口撃は、ほとんど鳳の耳に届いていないようだった。テーブルにべったり頬を付け、いかにも退屈といった態で、紙ナプキンに落書きを始めている。
lines.english: My counterattack hardly reached Otori. One cheek plastered to the table, every inch of him announcing boredom, he began doodling on a paper napkin.

lines.japanese: 「はあー、つまんね……つまんねー、つまんねーよお、成田隼人つまんねえよーう」
lines.english: “God, I'm bored... So bored, so bored. Hayato Narita, you are boooring.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、うぜぇ……なんだこいつ、カミ食ってブッ飛んでたときよりよっぽど鬱陶しいな」
lines.english: “God, you're obnoxious... What the hell? You're worse this way than when you were flying on *Kami*.”

lines.japanese: 鳳のミリペンが紙ナプキンの上をぐいーぐいーと滑る。最初こそ人物の顔っぽい輪郭があったが、すぐに乱雑な線の群れに塗りつぶされた。描きたいものが定まらないのかもしれない。
lines.english: Otori's technical pen dragged back and forth across the napkin. At first there had been something like the outline of a face, but it was soon buried under a mob of careless strokes. Maybe he couldn't settle on what he wanted to draw.

lines.japanese: 「もう俺、生き甲斐を失っちゃってさあ、あの日からずっとアトリエで絵ェ描いてるか、たまにヘテロでダベってるかどっちかだよ」
lines.english: “I've lost my reason to live. Since that day, all I do is draw in the studio or occasionally hang around Hetero talking.”

lines.japanese: 「つまり仕事と余暇じゃねーか。普通だよ、それが普通のオトナだよおまえ」
lines.english: “So, work and leisure. That's normal. That's a normal adult life.”

lines.japanese: 「ものには順序ってモンがあんでしょー。俺はまだ普通のコドモをやってないの、やる暇なかったの。だから、普通のオトナの前に普通のコドモをやりたかったんだよ」
lines.english: “Things have an order. I never got to be a normal kid. Never had time. So before I became a normal adult, I wanted my turn at being an ordinary child.”

lines.japanese: 安心しろ。そのワケ分からん言い分は、まさに子供のワガママだ。
lines.english: Rest easy. That incomprehensible grievance was exactly the selfish demand of a child.

lines.japanese: 「なんなんだ、おまえ。恨みごとでも並べに来たのか。だったらお悩み相談所にでも電話してろ。２４時間、声だけ綺麗なお姉さんが話聞いてくれッから。な？」
lines.english: “What, you here to air your grievances? Call an advice line. Some woman with a nice voice will listen twenty-four hours a day. Okay?”

lines.japanese: 「はん。恨みごとなんて言うくらいなら、とっくに俺、おまえのことフルボッコにしてるって。これ恨みごとじゃなくて、単なる嫌味だから。悪いけどこの先ずーっと、ねちねち言いつづけるよ」
lines.english: “Hah. If I wanted to air grievances, I'd have beaten you to a pulp already. This isn't a grievance, just spite. Sorry, but I plan to needle you about it forever.”

lines.japanese: 「オイオイなんだよ、意外と女々しいぞこの皇帝」
lines.english: “Whoa. The Emperor can be awfully whiny when he wants to.”

lines.japanese: 「まったくさあ。どうしてくれンだよ、フレイムバーズだって、そもそも伽楼羅のために作ったんだぜ。俺ヤンキーじゃないんだし、あいついないんじゃ意味ねーじゃん」
lines.english: “Seriously, what am I supposed to do? I built the Flame Birds for Karura in the first place. I'm no delinquent. Without him, it's pointless.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ解散しろよ」
lines.english: “Then disband.”

lines.japanese: 「ばーか、おまえの命令なんか聞かねえよ。ま、でも解散っていうか解体ンなるけどね、じきに」
lines.english: “Idiot. Like I'd obey you. Though I suppose it'll be dismantled soon enough, whether that's disbanding or not.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　そうなの」
lines.english: “Huh? Really?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。俺が降りたあと、跡目争いで内側からヒビ入っちゃって。いいかげん警察とヤーさんの締め付けもキツくなってたし。チームがデカくなり過ぎちゃって、シャレが通じなくなってきちゃったみたい。あはは」
lines.english: “Yeah. After I stepped down, the succession fight cracked it from within. The police and yakuza had been tightening the screws for ages too. The team got so big the joke stopped being funny, I guess. Ha ha.”

lines.japanese: あははじゃねーよ。
lines.english: Nothing funny about that.

lines.japanese: もうホント今更だけど、俺にはこいつの面白い面白くないの基準がさっぱり分かんねえ。
lines.english: It was absurdly late to be realizing it, but I still had no idea where this man drew the line between funny and unfunny.

lines.japanese: 「ま、ともかく俺は伽楼羅が戻ってくる日を信じて、今後とも末永くおまえらを監視させてもらうから」
lines.english: “Anyway, I’m counting on Karura coming back, so I’ll be keeping you people under watch for a good long time.”

lines.japanese: やつは手を止め、真正面から俺を凝視した。
lines.english: His hand stopped. He stared straight into me.

lines.japanese: ずずずー。俺は注文したアイスコーヒーを勢いよく啜った。
lines.english: *Slurrrp.* I took a long, noisy pull at my iced coffee.

lines.japanese: 「あはは、長い付き合いになりそうだねえ」
lines.english: “Ha ha. Looks like we're in for a long relationship.”

lines.japanese: ずず、ず、ず……あっという間に呑みほしてしまった。
lines.english: *Slurp, slurp, sl—* I had drained it in no time.

lines.japanese: はあ……。
lines.english: I sighed.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうだ。今後は俺がじきじき様子を見に来なくても、身内にいいスパイがいたんだった」
lines.english: “Oh, right. From now on, I don't even need to check on you myself. I have an excellent spy in the family.”

lines.japanese: 「……うるせえよ」
lines.english: “...Shut up.”

lines.japanese: まず鳳が、次いで俺が、隣りテーブルの鳴へと視線を向けた。やつはもともとチラチラこちらを窺っていたから、すぐに目がかち合った。たちまち椅子から飛びだしてくる。
lines.english: First Otori, then I, looked toward Naru at the next table. She'd already been peeking our way, so our eyes met instantly. She sprang from her chair.

lines.japanese: 「あのーう、うちの翔が、なにか失礼なこと申したりしてませんでしょうかー」
lines.english: “Um, has my Kakeru said anything terribly rude to you?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　ああ、言ってるけど。普通に。むしろ失礼しか言ってないけど」
lines.english: “Huh? Yeah. Routinely. Rude is more or less all he's said.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ！？　ちょっと、やめてよもう！」
lines.english: “What?! Hey, stop that!”

lines.japanese: うお、すげえ。あいつ今、柳木原フレイムバーズ最強の男に猫パンチ入れたぞ。
lines.english: Whoa. Amazing. She just gave the strongest man in the Yanagihara Flame Birds a little kitty-paw swat.

lines.japanese: 「えー、大丈夫だよ。俺と隼人の仲だし、それ言ったらこいつだって結構ひでえこと言ってるもん」
lines.english: “Oh, it's fine. Hayato and I go way back. Besides, if we're discussing rudeness, he's said some awful things himself.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、まあな。いまさら俺、こいつの言うこといちいち真に受けねーし。今日なんかまだマシな方だろ、なにせ今までがガンギマリのイカレジャンキーだった──」
lines.english: “Yeah, fair. It’s not like I take him seriously anymore. Today’s mild. Until now he was a junkie stoned out of his skull—”

lines.japanese: がしっ！
lines.english: *Clamp!*

lines.japanese: それは戦士の速度だった。対面に座っていたはずの鳳が、いつの間にか俺の背後へ回って、あの燃える猛禽の翼で俺の肩を抱いていた。笑顔で。
lines.english: It was a warrior's speed. Otori had been seated across from me; now he was somehow behind me, one blazing raptor wing wrapped around my shoulders. Smiling.

lines.japanese: 「あははは、ほら、俺たちこんなに仲良しなんだ」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! See? The two of us are the best of friends.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、いた、いたたた何すんだおまえいきなり」
lines.english: “Ow—hey, that hurts! What the hell are you doing?”

lines.japanese: 「まぁまぁまぁまぁ」
lines.english: “Now, now, now, now.”

lines.japanese: やつの筋力がどれほどのものかは俺もよく知っている。冬の外套に覆われて見えないが、俺の首筋をロックした左腕はひそかに硬く盛りあがっていた。
lines.english: I knew precisely how strong he was. His winter coat hid it, but the left arm locked around my neck had quietly bunched hard beneath the cloth.

lines.japanese: 「お、おまえ……もしかして、妹には裏の顔……隠してたのか……？」
lines.english: “Y-you... Don't tell me you've hidden your other face... from your sister...?”

lines.japanese: 「まぁまぁまぁまぁ」
lines.english: “Now, now, now, now.”

lines.japanese: そういうことか……このシスコンが……。
lines.english: So that was it... You sister-obsessed freak...

lines.japanese: 「あああやめてちょっと、もうやだこの兄！　はやく隼人さんから離れてよう、恥ずかしいなあ！」
lines.english: “Stop it! God, I hate this brother! Get away from Hayato already. This is so embarrassing!”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ、恥ずかしいとか言うことないだろ……」
lines.english: “Come on. You don't have to call me embarrassing...”

lines.japanese: あ、妹に説教されて微妙に傷付いてる。
lines.english: Oh. Scolded by his little sister, he was actually a little hurt.

lines.japanese: おもしれーな、この兄妹。
lines.english: These siblings were hilarious.

lines.japanese: つーか鳴の方も、兄貴相手だとずいぶんカンジ違うんだな。声からして対肉親用になってる。
lines.english: Naru was completely different with her brother too. Even her voice had switched to its family setting.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、ちょっと安心した。家じゃ鳴って、けっこう内弁慶なんじゃん」
lines.english: “Huh. That's actually a relief. So at home you're pretty bold, Naru.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ？　なんのことですかしら？」
lines.english: “My? Whatever could you mean?”

lines.japanese: いや、バックレんなよ。無理だろもう、現行犯だし。
lines.english: Don't play dumb. Too late now; caught in the act.

lines.japanese: 「やー私、家ではもう、目覚めにローズティーお休み前はジャスミンティーといった具合でして、それはそれは優雅なスローライフを送っておりますねー」
lines.english: “Why, at home I start my day with rose tea and end it with jasmine tea. Mine is a life of elegant leisure.”

lines.japanese: 「んん……？　まあ、たしかに、そういうの似合いそうな家ではあったけど……」
lines.english: “Hm...? Well, I guess your house did look like the sort of place where that would fit...”

lines.japanese: 「お気に入りのペストリーはシナモンスコーンとブルーベリーマフィンですよー」
lines.english: “My favored pastries are cinnamon scones and blueberry muffins.”

lines.japanese: 「え、おまえがいつも食ってんの、モンキで段ボール買いしてきたポテトチップじゃん。袋逆さまにして、最後のひと粉が口に入るまで延々振りつづけるよね。たまに目ぇ入って、ギャーギャー騒いでるけど」
lines.english: “What? You always eat those potato chips you buy by the carton at Monki Hote. You turn the bag upside down and shake forever until the last speck falls into your mouth. Sometimes it gets in your eye and you run around screaming.”

lines.japanese: 「まぁまぁまぁまぁ」
lines.english: “Now, now, now, now.”

lines.japanese: 今度は鳴が動いた。
lines.english: This time Naru moved.

lines.japanese: 「いて、いててて、なに、なんだよ」
lines.english: “Ow, ow, ow! What? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと黙ってて、ほんとに。面白くないから。かーくん知らないと思うけど、世間的には私、清楚なイメージで通ってるし、そういう誤解を招く発言しないで」
lines.english: “Be quiet. Seriously, you're not funny. You may not know this, Kaa, but society at large knows me for my pure, refined image. Stop saying things that might give people the wrong idea.”

lines.japanese: 「や、誤解もなにも事実じゃん」
lines.english: “What misconception? It's true.”

lines.japanese: 「黙って。ほんと怒るよ。お願いだから空気読んで。本気で恥ずかしいからやめて」
lines.english: “Be quiet. I really will get angry. Please read the room. This is honestly humiliating. Stop.”

lines.japanese: 「いや……いいよもう、ぜんぶ聞こえてるし……つか、恥ずかしいってより微笑ましいじゃん。むしろ好感持てるって」
lines.english: “It's... fine. I heard all of it. And rather than humiliating, it's kind of endearing. Makes me like you better, if anything.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　えー、やー、そうですかー、たはーはー」
lines.english: “What? Oh—well, if you say so. Hah... ha.”

lines.japanese: 「るー。女の子なんだから口は閉じなさい」
lines.english: “Roo. You're a girl. Close your mouth.”

lines.japanese: 「もう、かーくんうるさい」
lines.english: “God, Kaa, be quiet.”

lines.japanese: ふーん。
lines.english: Huh.

lines.japanese: もっとぎくしゃくした関係かと思ってたけど、なんだ、こいつら意外と対等に主張しあってるじゃねえか。
lines.english: I'd imagined their relationship was more strained. But look at that. They were surprisingly comfortable asserting themselves as equals.

lines.japanese: ていうより、むしろこれはフツーに──
lines.english: More than that, this was perfectly ordinary—

lines.japanese: 「なあなあ成田君、あのふたり最近やけに仲いいよなあ！」
lines.english: “Hey, Narita. Haven't those two gotten awfully close lately?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 隣りのテーブルの三人組が、鳳兄妹を眺めてにやにやへらへら笑っていた。
lines.english: The trio at the next table watched the Otori siblings with idiot grins plastered across their faces.

lines.japanese: 最近、とか言われても、俺はこの取り合わせに遭遇したのなんて今日が初めてだから、以前のことは分からない。
lines.english: He could say 'lately,' but this was my first encounter with the pair together. I didn't know what they'd been like before.

lines.japanese: 「Ｈｕｈ、家族の仲がいいことなんざ照れる必要どこにもねえのに、あいつらこういうの慣れないもんだから、反抗期迎えた小六みてえに無駄な羞恥心が拭いきれな──」
lines.english: “Huh. There's no shame in getting along with family. They aren't used to it, that's all. Can't shake the pointless self-consciousness, like sixth-graders entering their rebellious phase—”

lines.japanese: 「アァーッウチ！」
lines.english: “Owwwch!”

lines.japanese: 今度は兄と妹が同時に動いた。
lines.english: This time brother and sister moved together.

lines.japanese: 「まぁまぁまぁまぁ」
lines.english: “Now, now, now, now.”

lines.japanese: 「まぁまぁまぁまぁ」
lines.english: “Now, now, now, now.”

lines.japanese: 「ノオォォォーッ！　いっだだだ、まま待ってくれよ皇帝！　違うんだ、ちょいとこの口がキャサリーヌの貞操観念みたいに、うっかり緩くなっちまって……ひぎい！」
lines.english: “Nooo! Ow, ow, wait, Emperor! You’ve got it wrong. My mouth just got loose, like Catherine’s morals— Eeeagh!”

lines.japanese: ふたりがダジャレ豚の鼻をねじり上げるタイミングは、見事にぴったり息が合っていた。
lines.english: Brother and sister twisted the pun-pig's nose in flawless unison.

lines.japanese: 「はっ、なんだかんだ言って仲いいンじゃん、おまえら」
lines.english: “Ha! For all your complaining, you two get along fine.”

lines.japanese: しかしそれは失言だった。
lines.english: That was the wrong thing to say.

lines.japanese: 「まぁまぁまぁまぁ」
lines.english: “Now, now, now, now.”

lines.japanese: 「まぁまぁまぁまぁ」
lines.english: “Now, now, now, now.”

lines.japanese: 次の犠牲者は俺だった。
lines.english: Their next victim was me.

lines.japanese: 「じゃー俺ら、そろそろヘテロ行くわー」
lines.english: “Well, we should probably head over to Hetero.”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah?”

lines.japanese: 鳴の紅茶が冷めるほどの時間が過ぎたころ、連中ががたがたと席を立ちはじめた。
lines.english: By the time Naru's tea had gone cold, the others began scraping their chairs back.

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょー、隼人先輩もノンキに座ってねえで！　いっしょに弾けちゃいましょうよォ！」
lines.english: “Hey, hey! Don't sit there taking it easy, Hayato. Come cut loose with us!”

lines.japanese: 「今日は二時間ばかし俺も回すのよ～。レゲトン的なとこでは生でＬＲのラップ入れさせるから、コレ盛りあがっちゃうよ～」
lines.english: “I'll be spinning for a couple hours tonight too. When the reggaeton stretch hits, we'll have LR rap live over it. The place is gonna explode.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、マジで。面白そうだけど、悪りい、また今度な。俺これからバイトなんだ」
lines.english: “Seriously? Sounds fun, but sorry. Next time. I've got work.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ冷てえな成田君、俺たちのメイクレジェンドよりシケたメイクマネーを選ぶのかよ」
lines.english: “That's cold, Narita. You're choosing that dreary make-money over our make-legend?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえらだってソレ仕事なんだろ。そこの絵描き志望もぼちぼちやってるみてーだし、俺にもバイトぐらいさせろよ」
lines.english: “This is work for you too, isn't it? Even the aspiring artist seems to be doing a little. Let me have a job.”

lines.japanese: 「あーあ、なんかその充実した目がむかつく。みんなこうやってガキじゃなくなってくンだねえ」
lines.english: “Ugh. That look of purpose in your eyes pisses me off. So this is how everybody stops being a kid.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、そうみてーだな。俺もこれからは地道に稼いでくンだから、おめーら今後二度と、いつかみたいに爆音鳴らして冷やかし来たりすんじゃねーぞ」
lines.english: “Looks that way. I'll be earning an honest living from now on, so don't ever come heckle me again with the music blasting like that one time.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そんなこともあったねえ。んー……じゃ、ちょっと待って」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah. That happened. Hmm... Then wait a second.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 席を立っていた鳳が、歯でミリペンのキャップを外し、置きすてて行くはずだった紙ナプキンにさらりと何か一筆加えた。文字……なんだ、英語か？
lines.english: Already standing, Otori pulled the cap from his technical pen with his teeth and added a quick flourish to the paper napkin he had meant to leave behind. Letters...? Was that English?

lines.japanese: 「ハイ、これあげる。諸々の礼と詫びと記念と気まぐれに」
lines.english: “Here. Take it. Call it thanks, apology, memento, and whim.”

lines.japanese: ぐじゃぐじゃの落書きが差しだされた。なんだこのゴミ。もはや紙ナプキンとしての用途にさえも使えないじゃねーか。
lines.english: He offered me a tangle of scribbles. What was this garbage? It wasn't even usable as a paper napkin anymore.

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんなてめ、いらねえよこんな──」
lines.english: “Fuck that. I don't want this—”

lines.japanese: 「おわっ、ヤベえ！　ヤベえソウル、びんびん出まくってンじゃねースかこの絵！」
lines.english: “Whoa! That's insane! This thing is firing off some seriously intense soul!”

lines.japanese: 「エッ、これ絵だったの」
lines.english: “Wait, this is a picture?”

lines.japanese: 文房具売り場の試し書きメモ用紙にしか見えない。
lines.english: It looked like nothing but the scrap paper beside the test pens in a stationery aisle.

lines.japanese: 「成田っち、旧来の感性で理解しようと思っても、鳳凰寺カケルの芸術は理解できないのよ～。新しい目を開きなさ～い、そしたらそこに描かれた新しい成田隼人が見えてくるから～」
lines.english: “Narita, you'll never understand Kakeru Hououji's art with your old sensibilities. Open a new eye. Then you'll see the new Hayato Narita drawn there.”

lines.japanese: 「エッ、これ俺だったの」
lines.english: “Wait, this is me?”

lines.japanese: 「当たり前だろ。誰に見えんだよ」
lines.english: “Obviously. Who else would it be?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そもそもヒトに見えねー」
lines.english: “I couldn't even tell it was human.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、皇帝は印象派だからな」
lines.english: “Well. The Emperor *is* an Impressionist.”

lines.japanese: 「はは、皇帝はやめろよ左右田さん。俺もうパンピーなんだから」
lines.english: “Ha-ha. Quit calling me Emperor, Souda. I'm an ordinary civilian now.”

lines.japanese: 「いいや、あんたは俺らにとっちゃ永遠の皇帝、その名もエターナル・エンペラー」
lines.english: “No. To us, you're our eternal Emperor. The Eternal Emperor.”

lines.japanese: 「そうッスよ皇帝！　たとえ形はなくなっても、柳木原フレイムバーズの魂は永遠に不滅ッスよ！」
lines.english: “That's right, Emperor! The organization may be gone, but the soul of the Yanagihara Flame Birds is immortal!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはーっ、その通りじゃー！　よっしゃ、そんじゃここは景気付けに、いつものアレいっちゃう～！？」
lines.english: “Bwah! Damn right! All right, shall we fire ourselves up with the usual?”

lines.japanese: 「おっ！　いかれますかァ？　いっちゃいます的展開～？」
lines.english: “Oh! Are we doing it? Is this the part where we do the thing?”

lines.japanese: 「ウィーアー……」
lines.english: “We are...”

lines.japanese: 「永遠の！　フレイム！　バァァァーズ！」
lines.english: “The eternal! Flame! Biiiiirds!”

lines.japanese: 一方、鳴は他人のふりをして便所へ避難していた。
lines.english: Meanwhile Naru fled to the restroom, pretending not to know them.

lines.japanese: 俺と鳳も、無視して勝手に話を続けていた。
lines.english: Otori and I ignored them and carried on talking.

lines.japanese: 「俺にゃ理解できねーけど、なに、こんな絵が分かるやつには分かんの」
lines.english: “I don't understand it, but does this picture make sense to the people who do?”

lines.japanese: 「らしいよ。俺としちゃ、自分の目に映ってるものを若干誇張して出力してるだけなんだけど、世界は広いね、似たようなイカレ方してる金持ちがそれなりにいるみたいでさ」
lines.english: “Apparently. As far as I'm concerned, I only take what my eyes see, exaggerate it slightly, and put it out there. Big world, though. Seems there are a fair number of rich people broken in the same way I am.”

lines.japanese: 「へぇー。じゃ、もしかしたらおまえ、将来すげえ有名な画家とかなっちゃったりしてな」
lines.english: “Huh. Maybe you'll wind up an incredibly famous painter.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、十年ぐらいしたら、そのナプキンどっかの画廊に持ってきなよ」
lines.english: “Sure. Bring that napkin to some gallery in ten years.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「どうせ隼人は十年後もジリ貧だろうからね。ソレちゃんとサイン入れといたから、そのころには披露宴と二次会と家財道具一式揃えてまだ釣りが来るぐらいの値で売れるはずだよ」
lines.english: “You'll still be scraping by ten years from now, knowing you. I signed it properly, so by then it should sell for enough to cover the wedding reception, the after-party, and a houseful of furniture, with change to spare.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、マジかよ」
lines.english: “Hah! Seriously?”

lines.japanese: でかく出たもんだ。さすがは柳木原の元エンペラー、ビッグマウスもスケールが違う。
lines.english: Talk about going big. Only Yanagihara’s former Emperor could boast on that scale.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあしょーがねえや、宝クジ感覚でもらっといてやる」
lines.english: “Fine, then. I'll take it as a lottery ticket.”

lines.japanese: やつの予言が外れれば嫌みのタネになる。このきったねえゴミは大事に保管しておこう。
lines.english: If his prophecy failed, I'd have material to mock him with. I would preserve this filthy trash with the utmost care.

lines.japanese: 「んじゃ、またな」
lines.english: “Well. See you around.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　待てよ、忘れモンがあるだろ。ちゃんと持ってけよ」
lines.english: “What? Wait. You're forgetting something. Take her with you.”

lines.japanese: 「今日ンとこはおまえに任す。送ってってやんな、兄貴」
lines.english: “I'm leaving her to you today. Walk her home, big brother.”

lines.japanese: 「やだよ、冗談じゃない。送るかっつーの」
lines.english: “No. You've gotta be kidding. Like I'm walking her home.”

lines.japanese: やつは渋っていたけど、それが本心のはずはないから俺は待たなかった。
lines.english: He made a show of reluctance, but there was no chance he meant it. I didn't wait.

lines.japanese: 店を出てしばらく歩いたあと振りかえると、微妙に距離を開けて並ぶ兄妹の影が見えた。
lines.english: After I'd walked a little way from the shop, I looked back. The siblings' silhouettes moved side by side with an awkward measure of space between them.

lines.japanese: パルさんの目に映る俺と鳴って、もしかしてあんな感じだったのかな。
lines.english: Was that how Naru and I looked through Paru's eyes?

lines.japanese: 少し気恥ずかしくなって、小さな息をひとつ捨てた。
lines.english: A little self-conscious, I let out a quiet breath.

lines.japanese: 「さて働くぞ」
lines.english: “Right. Time to work.”

lines.japanese: ひとりになった俺はぶらぶらとヒゲカンの待つ現場へ向かった。
lines.english: Alone again, I ambled toward the job site where the Bearded Foreman was waiting.
